verdict.rationale: The auto-review docs cover every element of the story. You can disable reviews globally and re-enable them by keyword or label, limit them to certain branches, skip draft PRs, and pause after a set number of commits, all through `reviews.auto_review` settings. On-demand control comes from `@coderabbitai review`, `full review`, pause, resume and ignore commands. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that these trigger controls work as documented.
